integrity: The analytic proof and the finite checker are independent in method: the proof reduces neighborhoods to singleton color classes, while the checker evaluates the defining neighborhood condition directly and compares exact counts.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs and ordinary proper conflict-free coloring.
The finite verifier checks total order at most six and is corroborative; the all-orders result is proved analytically.
Originality is assessed against targeted database searches and inspected literature, not by an absolute uniqueness oracle.
title: Proper conflict-free colorings of complete multipartite graphs
